discovered_jobs.title: Student worker in Nasdaq Exchange Services Team
discovered_jobs.summary: Part‑time student role supporting exchange services: analyze system prices, calculate settlement prices, test products/data quality, support equity derivatives broker desk and margin/settlement analytics. Minimum ~20 hrs/week in central Stockholm.
discovered_jobs.why_relevant: Hands-on exchange/trading support role (derivatives, settlement, pricing) that builds relevant trading and analytics experience for juniors.

discovered_jobs.title: Internship - Spring/ Summer 2027
discovered_jobs.summary: Summer/spring internship in Stockholm. Interns are assigned to a sector- or product-specific team and assist with market research, presentations, financial models and live projects. Suitable for students (after 2 or 4 years of higher education); Swedish and English required.
discovered_jobs.why_relevant: Stockholm-based, junior internship that can be placed in research, trading or analytics teams—directly aligned with quant/markets/analytics career paths.

discovered_jobs.title: Student Analyst - Market Statistics
discovered_jobs.summary: Part-time (student) role supporting market statistics: quantitative analysis, BI/reporting (SAP Business Objects, Power BI), SQL/Python work on high‑granularity market datasets. 6‑month contract, Stockholm office.
discovered_jobs.why_relevant: Student analytics role working directly with market data, SQL/Python and BI — good junior entry into market analytics/research.

discovered_jobs.title: Open Application Sweden
discovered_jobs.team: General / Open application (Sweden) — candidate may be considered for IB, Research, Sales or Trading teams
discovered_jobs.summary: Open application for Stockholm-based roles. Pareto invites students and graduates with an analytical/commercial mindset, good academic results and interest in finance to submit CVs for consideration across departments.
discovered_jobs.why_relevant: Official Sweden open-application portal explicitly listing Stockholm — suitable route for junior candidates seeking entry into research, trading or analytics roles.

discovered_jobs.title: Student Worker to Nasdaq Nordic Listings Team
discovered_jobs.summary: Part‑time student role in Listings operations: maintain listings and client data, support content publishing, CRM/process improvement and cross‑team coordination. Central Stockholm office; at least two days/week.
discovered_jobs.why_relevant: Junior listings/operations position giving exposure to market structure, listings data and cross‑functional finance workflows — suitable for students.
